statement: let W := fun (A B : Finset ℕ) (n : ℕ) => ((A ×ˢ B).filter (fun t => t.1+t.2=n)).card; ∀ (m n : ℕ) (A B : Finset ℕ), n < m → (∀ a ∈ A, a < m) → (∀ b ∈ B, b < m) → W A B (n+m) ≤ min ((A.filter (fun a => n < a)).card) ((B.filter (fun b => n < b)).card)

plain_statement.zh: 用高端步长数限制伪命中的重数
plain_statement.en: Bound wrapped multiplicity by the smaller upper tail

brief.zh: 在进位层两个坐标都大于 n。固定一个坐标后另一个惟一，分别向两个高端集合单射。
brief.en: Both summands exceed n on the wrapped layer. Project injectively onto each upper tail.
